name: @w6w-apps/jobnimbus
description: Create and manage contacts, jobs, tasks and notes in JobNimbus, the field-service CRM built for roofing and exterior contractors.

w6w.longDescription:
JobNimbus is a field-service CRM built for roofing and other exterior/home-services contractors — contacts and jobs move through customer-configured workflows (Lead, Inspection, Approved, ...), with tasks, notes and file attachments hung off either one.

This app covers the core of JobNimbus's own "Open API": full read/write on Contacts and Jobs (get, list, create, update, and the soft-delete JobNimbus itself exposes as a status flip), plus creating and listing Tasks and Activities (notes) against either. Every JobNimbus record carries a `jnid` — the id every other action takes to address it — and every list read supports JobNimbus's own Elasticsearch-syntax `filter`, offset pagination, and sort.

Authentication is a single static API Key, scoped by an assignable JobNimbus "Access Profile," the same key used by JobNimbus's own third-party integrations (BirdEye, CompanyCam, Zapier, ...). A health check tracks JobNimbus's own status page; JobNimbus publishes no rate-limit headers, so quota headroom is declared unavailable rather than guessed.
